links.outcome: LLM accuracy and output formatting under increasing prompt burden (notes and questions)
links.effect: Accuracy and formatting deteriorated as the number of questions and notes rose; GPT-4-turbo-128k and Llama-3-70B were resilient up to 50 tasks, while smaller models failed with JSON and Omission errors.
links.quote: Performance deteriorated as the number of questions and notes increased.

links.outcome: Performance trends replicated on external public MedMCQA dataset
links.effect: External MedMCQA validation aligned with primary trends: GPT-4-turbo-128k accuracy stable from 5 to 50 questions with a minimal decrease at 75; Llama-3-70B held to 25 questions then declined.
links.quote: These validation results align with trends observed in the primary experiments.

unlisted_practices: Concatenating multiple notes and questions into one LLM query to cut API cost (up to 17-fold savings at 50 tasks)

openai.sample_unit: EHR question-answer pairs generated from 200 clinical notes

links.effect: In 250 reviewed pairs: evaluator 1 rated 234 T, 8 TI, 8 F; evaluator 2 rated 238 T, 4 TI, 8 F; agreement was 92.4%.
links.quote: The first evaluator rated 234 pairs as “T”, 8 as “TI”, and 8 as “F” (96.8% acceptable).

links.effect: GPT-4-turbo-128k failures were 3.82% (2.94–4.70%) in quartile 1 versus 13.66% (11.28–16.03%) in quartile 4.
links.quote: Specifically, GPT-4-turbo-128k had only 3.82% (2.94–4.70%) of failures in quartile 1 but 13.66% (11.28–16.03%) in quartile 4, indicating perhaps a bias towards questions presented earlier in the group.

links.effect: High-capacity GPT-4-turbo-128k and Llama-3–70B were superior; OpenBioLLM-8B and BioMistral-7B JSON failure rates were near 100%.
links.quote: There were significant differences in the performance of various LLMs across experiments as the prompt complexity increased.

links.effect: OpenBioLLM-8B and BioMistral-7B JSON failure rates were near 100%, preventing assessment of Omission errors.
links.quote: As the JSON failure rates were near 100% for OpenBioLLM-8B and BioMistral-7B, it was not possible to evaluate them for Omission errors.
